audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored Skill and Level 2 Heimerdinger, while the page's own whys[0] calls Level 1 'his single best window' and spikes[0] is titled 'Warwick's only window' at Lvl 1; whys[1] says Level 2 'is even'. Levels 4-5 were Skill despite whys[3] calling any walk-in suicidal.
audit.why: With one turret and no grenade, Blood Hunt move speed plus Jaws of the Beast's max-health-and-heal bite wins the only trade Warwick can force. By 4-5 three charges plus the grenade make the nest unenterable.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Warwick, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 Heimerdinger, Levels 4-5 Heimerdinger, Level 6 Skill, First item Heimerdinger, 2+ items Heimerdinger.

audit.why: All four spikes exist and are correctly timed — Warwick's Level 1, your Level 3 fence, his Level 6 Infinite Duress, and your first-item siege. Only the mechanics described inside spikes[2] were wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] asserts that Infinite Duress 'does not leap over your turrets — it has to run the gap'. The grenade is called 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' / 'the CH-3X center-stun' in whys[3], spikes[2], mid and wants.you[0]. Primal Howl is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: Infinite Duress is a leap whose distance scales with his bonus Move Speed, suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5s, and it is a channel — CC interrupts it. Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s, 970 range) and only 'anyone directly hit' is stunned. Primal Howl (E, 15/14/13/12/11s) gives him damage reduction for 2.5s and then fears nearby enemies for 1s — against Heimerdinger that fear walks you out of your own nest.
audit.corrected: Infinite Duress leaps, and it leaps further the more bonus move speed he has; the suppression is a channel, so any CC breaks it. Hold CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade's direct hit for that cast. Expect Primal Howl to fear you off your turret line and to blunt the burst that precedes it.
sources: brief enemyKit R (dash + channel flags, Riot text)

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6], early, mid and late are written in first person ('I', 'me', 'my'). packet.suspectNames also flagged 'Land Infinite Duress' in wants.foe[2] as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: The site's voice is second person. Infinite Duress is Warwick's real R name — that flag is a false positive.
audit.corrected: Converted to second person; no name change needed in wants.foe[2].

notes: spikes[2] carried a flatly false claim — that Infinite Duress 'does not leap over your turrets'. Riot's text says it leaps, scaling with bonus Move Speed, so a player who trusted that line would position wrong at 6. The 'CH-3X' grenade fabrication appears here too (whys[3], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[0]) as it does in heimerdinger__trundle and heimerdinger__volibear — a repo-wide sweep for 'CH-3X' across heimerdinger is warranted. Primal Howl was absent from the entire page and is now named in report[5]. packet.suspectNames flag on 'Land Infinite Duress' is a false positive.
